description: Recipe collection dossier (premium). Premium dossier over a region or cuisine of the Ni Biashara recipes shelf: the full dish records plus per-dish sourcing notes and substitution chains, with the snapshot's actual coverage named. Built for menu planning; coverage is what the shelf really holds, never invented dishes. $2.5 USDC on Base. Returns the x402 URL to GET (402 → PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → delivery). Free to call this tool; payment happens on the URL.

cuisine.description: exact cuisine, e.g. Kenyan (this or region required)

region.description: region text, e.g. Kenyan Coast (this or cuisine required)
